scope: Public-source follow-up for ICTPL Mumbai OCT exact berth-hire base-row linkage

confirmed.claim: 2018 approved tariff Chapter II 2.1 explicitly ties hourly OCT berth hire to 1.3 times MbPT berth hire as applicable from time to time. It does not literally name a specific MbPT dock row.

Current May2026 MbPA SOR2.17 has distinct ordinary foreign/coastal rows: Indira Dock/harbour walls/Ballard Pier/BPX USD0.0137/INR0.2165; Princes/Victoria docks and harbour walls USD0.0109/INR0.1676 per GRT per hour or part. OCT not separately listed.

TAMP27Mar2025 annual-indexation circular expressly addresses Indira Container Terminal Private Limited. It announces1.04% SOR annual indexation for1May2025-30Apr2026; it neither selects OCT dock base-row nor constitutes an OCT2026 tariff.

2021 government environmental dossier contains2017-18 provisional revenue model INR1.42/GRT-hour and a separate revival feasibility model INR1.35/GRT-hour. Its feasibility assumptions expressly require tariff notification before operations; these are not current charge sheets.

The same feasibility report says port dues and pilotage accrue to MbPT under its general SOR. This supports separating MbPA marine components from private OCT berth hire, without establishing which pilotage facility row applies.

Ministry circuler.pdf is26Sept2024 draft migration consultation; appended as-of1May2023 operator table discusses ICTPL interim MbPA tariff. It is supplementary historical context, not adopted migration or exact row authority.
confirmed.inspection: web original PDF cover checked; attachment table indexed

confirmed.claim: CurrentMumbaiSOR expressly mentionsOCT under dock-to-dock shifting and specificport-convenience movement rules. Separate ordinaryMbPA marine components should not be blocked merely because privateberthrow unresolved.

judgment.likely_base_row: Current2.17 row1 Indira/Ballard ordinary cargo row is a plausible comparison, because OCT substitutes for these working cargo berths and is linked from Indira Dock; this remains contextual inference.
judgment.why_not_closed: The cross-reference does not itself remove choice between multiple published berth schedules. The new financial models expressly use hypothetical upfront ARR pricing rather than actual ad-hoc1.3x billing, so they cannot calibrate the intended row.
do_not_do: Treat INR1.42 or INR1.35 model estimates as live tariff
